translation_en: Muhammad ibn Khalid narrated to us: Ubaydullah ibn Musa narrated to us, from Isra’il, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Abidah, from Abdullah, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “The last of the people of Paradise to enter Paradise and the last of the people of the Fire to come out of the Fire will be a man who crawls out. His Lord will say to him, ‘Enter Paradise.’ He will say, ‘My Lord, it is full.’ He will say that to him three times, and each time he will repeat, ‘It is full.’ Then He will say, ‘You will have the like of the world ten times over.’”

Ali ibn Hujr informed us: Isa ibn Yunus informed us, from al-A‘mash, from Khaythamah, from Adi ibn Hatim, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “There is none of you except that his Lord will speak to him, with no interpreter between them. He will look to his right and see only what he sent ahead of deeds; he will look to his left and see only what he sent ahead; and he will look in front of him and see only the Fire facing him. So protect yourselves from the Fire, even with half a date.” Al-A‘mash said: Amr ibn Murrah narrated to me, from Khaythamah, a similar report, adding, “even with a good word.”

Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Jarir narrated to us, from Mansur, from Ibrahim, from Abidah, from Abdullah, who said: A Jewish scholar came and said, “On the Day of Resurrection, Allah will place the heavens on one finger, the earths on one finger, the water and soil on one finger, and all creatures on one finger. Then He will shake them and say, ‘I am the King, I am the King.’” I saw the Prophet laugh until his molars appeared, in amazement and affirmation of what he said. Then the Prophet recited, “They have not appraised Allah with the appraisal due to Him…” through “they associate with Him” Quran 6:91.

Musaddad narrated to us: Abu Awanah narrated to us, from Qatadah, from Safwan ibn Muhriz, that a man asked Ibn Umar, “How did you hear the Messenger of Allah speak about private conversation?” He said: “One of you will draw near to his Lord until He covers him, then say, ‘Did you do such-and-such?’ He will say, ‘Yes.’ He will say, ‘Did you do such-and-such?’ He will say, ‘Yes.’ He will make him acknowledge it, then say, ‘I concealed it for you in the world, and today I forgive it for you.’” Adam said: Shayban narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us: Safwan narrated to us, from Ibn Umar, who said: I heard the Prophet.

Yahya ibn Bukayr narrated to us: al-Layth narrated to us: Uqayl narrated to us, from Ibn Shihab: Humayd ibn Abd al-Rahman narrated to us, from Abu Hurayrah, that the Prophet said: “Adam and Moses argued. Moses said, ‘You are Adam, who brought your descendants out of Paradise.’ Adam said, ‘You are Moses, whom Allah chose with His messages and speech, yet you blame me for something decreed for me before I was created.’ Thus Adam prevailed over Moses in the argument.”

Muslim ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: Hisham narrated to us: Qatadah narrated to us, from Anas, who said: The Messenger of Allah said, “The believers will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection and will say, ‘If only we sought intercession with our Lord, so He might relieve us from this place.’ They will go to Adam and say, ‘You are Adam, the father of humanity. Allah created you with His hand, made the angels prostrate to you, and taught you the names of everything. Intercede for us with your Lord so that He may relieve us.’ He will say to them, ‘I am not suited for that,’ and he will mention to them the mistake he committed.”
